login.title: Sign in to Tono
login.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a sign-in code.
login.intro: Sign in with a verified email to continue. No password is required.

suspended.title: Tono account suspended
suspended.description: Your account has been suspended. Please contact support for assistance.

restoreFailed.title: Couldn't restore your session
restoreFailed.description: Restoring your previous session failed. Retry, or sign in again below.

networkBlocked.title: Internet access is currently blocked
networkBlocked.description: Tono restored its leak protection from an earlier connection. Restore normal internet access before signing in.

errors.unreachable: Tono's server could not be reached. Your network closed the connection — this is the network in the way, not a problem with your account or the code. Signing in only has to succeed once: do it on a network that works (a phone hotspot, or with another VPN running in TUN or global mode), and it stays signed in afterwards.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.deviceLimit: This account is already on the maximum number of devices. Remove one from a signed-in device, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: That sign-in expired. Request a new code.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Reality cloud protection
dashboard.protectedOfflineDescription: Tono is blocking a direct leak. It will switch to a working route and retry.
dashboard.taglineIdle: One click routes every app through your selected Tono cloud.
dashboard.taglineConnected: All traffic is protected. Tono will block leaks if the route drops.
dashboard.directOn: WeChat and reviewed China sites can go direct. Everything else stays in the tunnel.
dashboard.directSkipped: China-direct is off this session. WeChat and the rest stay in the tunnel.
dashboard.pickServer: Choose a server to get started
dashboard.catalogRequiresChoice: Your server is no longer available — please reselect
dashboard.killSwitchErrorNote: Most recent error — it may already be resolved.

errors.serviceBusy: Tono Service is installing or repairing. Approve any pending admin prompt, or restart Tono.
errors.releaseReconciling: Network protection is still releasing. Wait a moment, then connect again.
errors.serviceTooOld: This Tono Service is too old for this app. Reinstall Tono from the latest installer so the Service is replaced.
errors.nodeUnreachable: This server could not be reached. Try again, or switch to another server.
errors.protectedHttpsFailed: Protected HTTPS did not complete (TLS handshake closed). If every server fails the same way, switching cities will not help — send diagnostics to support.
errors.coreUnpinned: This Tono install is missing its kernel check. Install the latest Tono — reinstalling the same copy will not help.
errors.coreMismatch: The Tono kernel does not match this install. Install the latest Tono.
errors.dnsPortBusy: Another app is using local DNS port 53. Close that app and try again.
errors.protectionReleaseFailed: Leak protection is still on, so this PC stays blocked. Try Restore normal internet again.

progress.statusTitle: This route did not pass the connection check
progress.statusBody: Tono is blocking a direct leak. It will switch to a working route and retry.
progress.restoreConfirmMessage: This will release network protection and restore normal Internet access.

upload.confirmMessage: This sends a diagnostics report to Tono, tied to your account: app and Windows version, the Tono Service protocol version, your selected server's name, connection state, kill-switch and DNS status and their last error messages, the connect steps with timings, whether a Hyper-V/WSL-style virtual adapter is present, and the paths of the local log files. It never sends your configuration, keys, tokens, server addresses, or the contents of any log file. Use Copy details first if you want to read the exact contents.
upload.successHint: Report uploaded. Give this reference code to Tono support:

errors.signedOut: You are signed out, so the report could not be linked to an account. Sign in and try again, or use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.rateLimited: Too many reports were uploaded recently. Wait a few minutes and try again, or use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach Tono. Check that you are online — if leak protection is blocking everything, restore normal internet first, then retry.
errors.unavailable: Diagnostics upload is not available on this account yet. Use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.failed: The upload failed. Use Copy details and send the text to support.

startup.stateInitRetrying: Tono cannot open its own data folder yet, and is retrying. This is usually a full disk or a user profile that is still coming online. It recovers on its own if the cause clears.
startup.stateInitFailed: Tono cannot open its own data folder, so it cannot start ({{error}}). Free up disk space or make sure your user profile is available, then start Tono again. If this PC has no internet, network protection may still be armed: open Command Prompt as Administrator and run tono-service.exe --emergency-disarm to release it.
